summary: Episode 99 discusses five companies with mixed signals. Academedia is viewed positively at reasonable P14 valuation but not owned. Björn Borg was sold after 127% gain as fair value reached. Elektra, a COVID winner with tough comps ahead, offers little appeal at P12. H&M is discussed as potential future defensive play but currently has no upside in their view. Komplett Bank looks cheap but opaque credit loss reporting prevents investment.
